title: MLOPS↔PO-001: Model Deployment Status & Health Reporting + Release Priorities/Windows
description: The MLOps Engineer provides deployment status, rollout schedules, and model-health reporting, plus pipeline-health status, the model-monitoring/drift-alert process, and deployment-readiness confirmation; the Product Owner/TPM provides the release schedule requiring model deployment/monitoring support, release priorities, approved rollout windows, and the acceptable risk tolerance for fleet changes. Grounded in MLOPS_ENGINEER_SKILL §6.8 and PRODUCT_OWNER_TECHNICAL_PROJECT_MANAGER_SKILL §6.5. This contract reports status and coordinates windows only; binding OTA rollout governance lives in the MLOPS→DEVOPS→FW→BACK chain (ADR-gated), and post-deployment drift maps to FC-022.

mlops_deployment_report.description: MLOPS→PO: deployment status, rollout schedule, model-health, pipeline-health, deployment readiness.

po_release_inputs.description: PO→MLOPS: release schedule/priorities, approved rollout windows, risk tolerance.

x-macp.tier_rationale: Routine model deployment-status and health reporting plus rollout-window coordination is agent-autonomous (release planning; rollout coordination; post-deployment review). Binding OTA rollout governance stays in the OTA chain (ADR-gated); a drift alert maps to FC-022 and feeds the post-deployment review.
x-macp.cadence: TRIGGER (release planning; rollout coordination; per-release checkpoint; post-deployment review; ad hoc on pipeline-blocking issues)
confirm_conditions: deployment status and deployment readiness are reported with the rollout schedule
model-health accuracy delta carries an explicit unit
pipeline health is stated; a drift alert is surfaced honestly
a rollout is coordinated against an approved window and the stated risk tolerance
reject_conditions: an accuracy-delta quantity emitted without a unit (units rule §3.10)
deployment_readiness = READY asserted while pipeline_health = DEGRADED/DOWN or a drift alert is active (Honesty Over Polish §10.3)
an OTA rollout-strategy change decided in this contract without the OTA-chain ADR
counter_conditions: a requested rollout window conflicts with pipeline health — request a window or risk-tolerance decision before scheduling
a drift alert during rollout implies a rollback — route the rollback through the OTA chain (MLOPS↔DEVOPS-001) and report status here
